card.name: "Consider" in drug interaction advice
card.fires_on: The word "consider" (or "Consider") starting a recommendation in drug interaction sections, often after a monitoring or avoidance statement. It usually precedes a dose change or an alternative drug.

modes.label: "Consider" before a dose change
modes.description: "Consider" introduces a dose adjustment, increase or reduction after an interaction is described.
modes.example: meprazole is co-administered with darunavir/ritonavir, monitor patients for decreased efficacy of omeprazole.<< Consider>> increasing the omeprazole dose in

modes.label: "Consider" before an alternative therapy
modes.description: "Consider" introduces switching to an alternative or alternate medication.
modes.example: When using esomeprazole magnesium,<< consider>> use of alternative anti-platelet therapy

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with the word "alternative" or "alternate", as in suggesting another medication.
card.plain: It responds to the word "consider" in interaction advice, where an alternative drug or an adjustment is about to be suggested.
